doc.title: roll
doc.body: Sound effect only: A hero rolls across packed earth: short rush of cloth and scuff of boots, low and soft, under half a second. No speech, words, music, or other sounds.

doc.title: dodge
doc.body: Sound effect only: A hero evades a blow with one nimble sidestep: quick airy swish, boot scrape and a faint high accent. No speech, words, music, or other sounds.

doc.title: hurt
doc.body: Sound effect only: A hero is hurt: one restrained low human pain grunt with a brief body-impact thud. No words or prolonged cry. No speech, words, music, or other sounds.

doc.title: pick
doc.body: Sound effect only: A small useful item is picked up: a delicate two-note bright chime with a short natural tail, warm fantasy game feel. No speech, words, music, or other sounds.

doc.title: fall
doc.body: Sound effect only: A hero falls to the ground: one low soft thud followed by a short settling scrape. No voice. No speech, words, music, or other sounds.

doc.title: heal
doc.body: Sound effect only: A healing ability restores a hero: a warm, brief ascending shimmer of gentle glassy tones, no music phrase. No speech, words, music, or other sounds.

doc.title: level
doc.body: Sound effect only: A hero gains a level: a short uplifting four-note bell flourish, clear and satisfying, about half a second. No speech, words, music, or other sounds.
